title: $180,000 Bitcoin, Pokemon cards feature in North Carolina divorce appeal
summary_full: A North Carolina appeals court upheld a divorce court's valuation of three Bitcoin at $180,000, Pokemon cards at $1,800 and its unequal division of marital assets. However, it overturned a $15,261.40 attorney’s fee award and an order requiring the husband to pay the entire forensic accountant’s bill, citing missing findings needed to establish the reasonableness of the fees.
